claim_boundary: state/action supervised separability input only; not a deployment gate, Q-learning result, composition result, or long-horizon result
common_random_number_contract: reference and alternatives use neutral evaluate_actions from the same pre-decision state and RNG; only Q1 reference commits
mode: evaluation-only dataset collection; no fitting and no RL training
model_input_contract: focal_encoded_state only; proposal_action indexes the Q-shaped output; Q1 and outcome fields forbidden to the fitter
sampling: data-blind without-replacement focal draws before eligibility; no replacement for ineligible rows
